messages.content: Who was responsible for your instruction when you joined the community?
Mara was my teacher. She could make an ordinary mistake very difficult to settle.
Are you able to visit that person these days?
Mara died some years ago. I can remember what she said, but I cannot sit before her and have another argument with her.
